forms.form:
te zullen wegdommelen
weg te zullen dommelen

examples.text: Het is gevaarlijk achter het stuur weg te dommelen.
Per ongeluk had ik het bad laten overlopen toen ik even weg was gedommeld op het kingsize motelbed.
Ze zagen hoe ik begon weg te dommelen, waarna ze hun kans schoon zagen.

Therefore, what the train of the future must do is offer a comfortable and enjoyable experience in well-designed carriages that (for example) have pleasant lighting, have seats that align with windows, and which are comfortable enough so that you can doze off without having to call your oesteopath as soon as you wake up.

glosses: A short unintentional nap, an instance of dozing off.
